shortDescription: American Eagle Outfitters NYSE:AEO beat second-quarter revenue estimates on Wednesday, helped by strong demand for Aerie intimates, sleepwear and apparel.The company posted quarterly revenue of $1.38 billion, above analysts' estimates of $1.37 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG.
